instruction: A crooked witch's cottage and garden at twilight: a bent chimney leaking green smoke, a bubbling cauldron on a fire in the yard, rows of glowing potion plants in violet and acid green, a scarecrow with a pumpkin head, a twig fence, hanging jars of fireflies, a black cat on a stump, and a broom leaning by the door.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene: Witch's Potion Garden. A crooked witch's cottage and garden at twilight: a bent chimney leaking green smoke, a bubbling cauldron on a fire in the yard, rows of glowing potion plants in violet and acid green, a scarecrow with a pumpkin head, a twig fence, hanging jars of fireflies, a black cat on a stump, and a broom leaning by the door. Style: whimsical gothic. Entirely procedural geometry and textures (no external assets; canvas-generated textures are allowed). Compose a full environment — ground/backdrop plus several distinct focal structures and rich supporting props — with style-appropriate materials, a deliberate lighting rig with shadows, atmospheric depth (fog or a gradient sky where fitting), and subtle looping animation on at least three elements. Include OrbitControls with gentle auto-rotate, ACES filmic tone mapping, and a seeded PRNG so the layout is reproducible. Target roughly 600-700 lines of well-organized code.
